capabilities: Upload local images to S3-compatible cloud storage
Replace local image links with remote public URLs
Browse and select images in a gallery modal
Delete or retain local files per configurable policies
Auto-scan the vault periodically for eligible images
disambiguation: Not a cross-device sync tool; it offloads images to cloud storage and rewrites note links.
extras: Documentation is provided in both English and Chinese. The README states the fork's refactoring and documentation were generated with assistance from Gemini (AI model). Auto-scan and delayed delete work on desktop only. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: a highly refined and redesigned fork of the original perinchiang/obsidian-plugins-attachment-imagebed-manager
problem: Obsidian keeps images as local attachments, which bloats the vault and requires manual uploading and relinking if you want images served from cloud storage.

relations.evidence: This repository is a highly refined and redesigned fork of the original perinchiang/obsidian-plugins-attachment-imagebed-manager.

requires.name: S3-compatible storage (Cloudflare R2, AWS S3, MinIO, or custom)

summary: Uploads local note images to S3-compatible storage (Cloudflare R2, AWS S3, MinIO) and replaces local Markdown links with remote public URLs.
